fields.description: The pushed commit this request deploys.
fields.label: Commit
Status
fields.options:
Queued
Validating

Succeeded

fields.description: The X-GitHub-Delivery of the push, for tracing.
fields.label: GitHub Delivery

fields.description: What the deploy agent last reported. Empty until the agent takes the build.
fields.label: Build Status

fields.description: When the deploy agent last reported. Central fails the build once the agent stays silent too long.
fields.label: Build Reported At

fields.description: What the deploy agent last reported about the release. Empty until the image is built.
fields.label: Release Status

fields.description: When the deploy agent last reported on the release. Central fails the release once the agent stays silent too long.
fields.label: Release Reported At

fields.description: What the user sees when the deploy failed.
fields.label: Error

fields.description: The build's output as the deploy agent sent it. Past 1 MiB, it keeps the start and the newest lines.
fields.label: Build Log

fields.description: The release's output: the health check, and the new container's log when it failed. Past 1 MiB, it keeps the start and the newest lines.
fields.label: Release Log

fields.description: The VM size this deploy runs on, from the commit's frappe_cloud_deploy.toml or the defaults.
fields.label: Machine

fields.description: The server plan the VM runs and is billed at, from machine.size in the commit's config, else Central Settings' Default Deploy Size.
fields.label: Plan

fields.description: What the new container must answer before traffic moves to it, from the commit's frappe_cloud_deploy.toml or the defaults.
fields.label: Health Check

fields.description: Must return 2xx. Empty means any HTTP answer on / will do.
fields.label: Health Path

fields.description: Seconds the new container gets to answer.
fields.label: Health Timeout
